# De-dup review

Published lncrawl plugins whose site name matches a Keiyoushi / LNReader site on a different domain.
They are NOT skipped (`needsReview: true`). Decide each in `overrides.json`: `keep` or `skip` (optionally with `use`).

| plugin | its domain | looks like | their domain |
|---|---|---|---|
| Fuyu Novel (`lncrawl-fuyunovel`) | fuyu-novel.my.id | OssanTL (lnreader) | ossantl.my.id |
| Novel Bin (`lncrawl-novel-bin`) | novel-bin.com | Novel Bin (lnreader) | novelbin.com |
| Novel Bin Net (`lncrawl-novel-bin.net`) | novel-bin.net | Novel Bin (lnreader) | novelbin.com |
| Novelbin Net (`lncrawl-novelbin.net`) | novelbin.net | Novel Bin (lnreader) | novelbin.com |
